description: T1 (1 x Lime): crown reduction by about 2.5m and crown thinning; to suitable secondary growth points and no more than previous most recent points of reduction, and retaining at least 50% of fine branch structure; providing a naturally flowing canopy outline; retaining shortened furnishing growth for crown continuity; to prevent branch contact with building and allowing more light into surrounding windows and front garden. Removal of basal and epicormic growth from main stem up to 6m in height; to reduce and prevent obstruction to footpath and provide sufficient clearance to property, and allowing more light into surrounding windows and front garden.T2 (1 x Lime): crown reduction by about 2.5m and crown thinning; to suitable secondary growth points and no more than previous most recent points of reduction, and retaining at least 50% of fine branch structure; providing a naturally flowing canopy outline; retaining shortened furnishing growth for crown continuity; to prevent branch contact with building and allowing more light into surrounding windows and front garden. Removal of basal and epicormic growth from main stem up to 6m in height; to reduce and prevent obstruction to footpath and provide sufficient clearance to property, and allowing more light into surrounding windows and front garden.
